title: Support nested orchestrator delegation with configurable recursion limits
task_summary: Allowed tasks in a workflow with assign_to pointing to an orchestrator account to resolve to an ORCHESTRATOR role session, creating a sub-orchestrator. Programmed automatic parent task ID tracking and prompt reframing to convey delegating responsibility. Built configuration limits guarding against runaway recursion depth.

previous_step_review.checked: src/clients/jules.py, src/clients/local_db.py, src/core/coordinator.py, src/core/session_runner.py, src/api/execute.py, src/api/server.py

files_changed.change: Added max_delegation_depth: int = 0 to Settings class.
Modified run_task to support nested orchestrator sessions, climbing parent_task_id hierarchy to enforce depth limit, setting parent IDs, and reframing prompts.
Added test_orchestrator_delegation_and_recursion_limit verifying proper delegation and recursion enforcement.

assumptions_verified.verification: Climbed parent_task_id tree to accurately measure active nesting depth.
Validated max_delegation_depth = 0 disables delegation completely, defaulting to standard worker task logic.

decisions.decision: Acquire role AccountRole.ORCHESTRATOR instead of WORKER
decisions.reasoning: When delegation conditions are satisfied, acquiring the orchestrator role is exactly what configures the session to be a standing orchestrator.

self_review.checked: All modified files, schema, and test executions.
